annotation.title_clean: Commission Regulation (EU) 2015/562 of 8 April 2015 amending Regulation (EU) No 347/2012 with regard to advanced emergency braking systems
annotation.title_en: Commission Regulation (EU) 2015/562 of 8 April 2015 amending Regulation (EU) No 347/2012 with regard to advanced emergency braking systems
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Regulation amending EU type-approval rules for advanced emergency braking systems in heavy motor vehicles. It revises warning and activation test requirements for approval level 2, including timing of warnings, speed reduction and target speeds, aligning with UNECE Regulation No 131.
key_provisions_or_claims: Replaces points 2.4.2.1 and 2.4.2.2 of Annex II to Regulation 347/2012 on warning modes.
Replaces Appendix 2 with pass/fail values for approval level 2 warning and braking activation tests.
Sets target speed of 12±2 km/h for vehicles over 8t and 67±2 km/h for ≤8t, to be reviewed before 1 November 2021.
Aligns requirements with UNECE developments; enters into force on the twentieth day after publication.
